```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
all_ovlp = list()
sel_comparisons = c("IM_vs_non-IM_all_samples","IM_591_vs_NonIM","IM_592_vs_NonIM","IM_594_vs_NonIM","IM_all_vs_NormalAntrum","Colon_vs_HealthyAntrum","Duod_vs_HealthyAntrum")
fc_threshold = 0.5
for (n in sel_comparisons) {
  tmp = all_results[[n]]
  r_up = subset(tmp, padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange > fc_threshold & !(GeneSymbol=="" | GeneSymbol=="NA"))
  r_down = subset(tmp, padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange < -fc_threshold & !(GeneSymbol=="" | GeneSymbol=="NA"))
  
  for (gs in names(sc_sets)) {
    set_genes = sc_sets[[gs]]
    all_ovlp[[paste0(n,"_UP_",gs)]] = intersect(set_genes, r_up$GeneSymbol)  
    all_ovlp[[paste0(n,"_DOWN_",gs)]] = intersect(set_genes, r_down$GeneSymbol)
    
    ll = list()
    ll[[gs]]=set_genes
    ll[[paste0(n,"_UP")]] = r_up$GeneSymbol
    ll[[paste0(n,"_DOWN")]] = r_down$GeneSymbol
    
    p = ggvenn(ll, set_name_size = 4) 
    print(p)
    
  }
}
  
  
```

# GSVA

```{r}
count_mat = as.matrix(norm_counts[,grepl("^X4", colnames(norm_counts))])
rownames(count_mat) <- norm_counts$GeneSymbol
res_gsva = gsva(count_mat, sc_sets)
#colnames(res_gsva) = ed[gsub("X","", colnames(res_gsva)), "Library.Name"]

col_anno = ed[gsub("^X", "", colnames(count_mat)), c("Patient","Condition")]
rownames(col_anno) = paste0("X", rownames(col_anno))

```

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=6}

pheatmap(res_gsva, annotation_col = col_anno, labels_col = ed[gsub("^X", "", colnames(count_mat)), "Library.Name"])

res_gsva_s <- res_gsva[, order(col_anno[colnames(res_gsva), "Condition"], col_anno[colnames(res_gsva), "Patient"] ) ]
pheatmap(res_gsva_s, annotation_col = col_anno, labels_col = ed[gsub("^X", "", colnames(res_gsva_s)), "Library.Name"], cluster_cols = F)

```

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
rr_ts <- reshape2::melt(res_gsva)
colnames(rr_ts) <- c("Cluster", "Sample", "Score")
rr_ts$Sample <- gsub("^X","", rr_ts$Sample)

rr_ts <- merge(rr_ts, ed, by.x="Sample", by.y="sampleID", all.x=T)
rr_ts$Patient <- ifelse(rr_ts$Condition=="Normal Antrum", "Normal Antrum", ifelse(rr_ts$Condition %in% c("Colon", "Duodenum"), "Intestine", rr_ts$Patient))
ggplot(rr_ts, aes(x=Condition, fill=Patient, y = Score)) + geom_boxplot() + facet_wrap(~Cluster) + geom_hline(yintercept=0, lty=2) + theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45, hjust=1))


ggplot(subset(rr_ts, !Sample %in% c("4039_Y","4446_P","4446_Q","4446_R","4446_S")), aes(x=Condition, fill=Patient, y = Score)) + geom_boxplot() + facet_wrap(~Cluster) + geom_hline(yintercept=0, lty=2) + theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=45, hjust=1)) + ggtitle("Only good normal stomach samples")
```
